answer.summary: Verify the presence of explicitly reported, numerically specified, and time-bound memory retention thresholds in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 prior to advancing any research question on memory persistence duration.
answer.content: The investigation must confirm whether Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 contains explicit, quantitative, and time-bound metrics for memory retention (e.g., minimum input duration for detectable state persistence). If such thresholds are absent, a narrowly defined research question on the minimum duration of periodic input required for observable memory persistence under known perturbations will be formulated, strictly anchored to the source text and without external assumptions. Acceptance requires direct citation and numerical specification from the source section in question.

answer.lesson: All memory research must first verify explicit, numerically specified, and time-bound decay metrics in primary sources before any empirical or comparative analysis can proceed; absence of such data invalidates the research premise and necessitates a pivot to a narrowly defined, testable data point such as minimum retention duration thresholds
